notes: Runs execute against an isolated copy of mobile/ so they never collide with the live repo. Sandbox: .claude/skills/mobile-ui-design-workspace/sandbox/mobile (node_modules symlinked).

evals.name: serial-search-messy-complaint
evals.prompt: the serial search page on the phone looks old and messy, the colors are all over the place and it doesnt look proffesional like the rest. fix it properly
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis of the real defects (60 raw hex values, colour without meaning, kit bypass, archetype-7 failures), then a rebuilt screen using theme tokens and the ui kit. tsc clean.

evals.name: tasks-make-professional
evals.prompt: make the tasks screen look more professional and easier to scan, my supervisors use it every day
evals.expected_output: Hierarchy fix (one primary action, grouped density), semantic colour only, tokens instead of the 30 raw hex values, real loading/empty/error states. tsc clean.

evals.name: new-screen-born-consistent
evals.prompt: add a new screen for tyre men that lists the tyres due for replacement on an asset they pick, with the worst ones first
evals.expected_output: A new screen that is consistent from birth: Screen/Card/Badge/ListRow/EmptyState from the kit, tokens only, archetype-appropriate layout (picker then register), i18n keys in en.json AND ar.json, verified Ionicons glyphs, RTL-safe. tsc clean.
